NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS.
APR 1 6 1939
03934

Pig Hongs Menaced
By Bombs
Threatened By Terrorists
If They Join New Hongkew
Cattle Monopoly

Two hand grenades and two bullets were sent to two Chinese pig hong managers in Shanghai yesterday by unknown persons, who alleged that the managers are participating or have participated in the newly-established Shanghai Cattle Market in Hongkew which is trying to monopolize the transportation and sale of live stock here but which is stated to be an "illegal organization" by 50 pig hongs which have publicly denounced the scheme.

It was predicted yesterday, that the wordy war between two groups of pig dealers might be followed by action. At least two pig hong managers in the French Concession and Settlement were known to have received bombs yesterday but fortunately the men who presented the "gifts" did not mean to cause explosions. It was feared last night that since the dispute has already been transformed into threats and since the threatening letters which accompanied the missiles were printed some other pig hong managers have been or will be similarly victimized.

Menacing Gifts

A middle-aged Chinese man appeared at the door of a house at 494 Rue Lafayette at about 2.30 p.m. yesterday and after being ushered in, he said that he had been asked to present a gift to the master. No sooner had he finished his statement than he left behind a letter and a parcel which was later found to be containing one hand grenade and two bullets. The sender made his escape.

The master of the house is Mr. Koo Po-hsian, a well-known pig dealer in the Concession. It could not be ascertained yesterday where he stood in the present dispute, but it was alleged in the letter sent to him that he had already participated in the new Japanese-sponsored cattle market and that if did not dissociate himself from the new monopoly his life would be endangered.

While the French police were investigating this case last night, another "bomb gift" was presented to another pig hong manager whose hong, Wan Sheng Pig Hong, is at House No. 21 Lane 118 Chekiang Road. At about 8 p.m. a man went to the hong and, knocking at the door, asked to have an interview with the manager, Mr. Li Cheng-tsai, saying that he had a gift for him.

A Misunderstanding

When told that Mr. Li was not in, he asked a hong assistant to open a side door and presented a parcel and a letter. The parcel was found to contain a hand grenade and letter warning Mr. Li against moving to Hongkew. Such a move, the letter said, would be tantamount to "selling the country and race." The matter was later referred to the Louza police. It was ascertained that the victimized hong had advertised in Chinese newspapers that it would not join the new Hongkew market and it was suspected therefore by those connected with the hong that it was a case of misunderstanding.

The new cattle market building has not been ready yet for occupation but its temporary office is at 52 Yochow Road in Hongkew.

《字林西报》
1939年4月16日
03934

猪行遭炸弹威胁
若加入新虹口牲畜垄断组织
将受恐怖分子威胁

昨日，不明身份人士向上海两名华籍猪行经理寄送了两枚手榴弹和两发子弹，声称这些经理参与或曾参与新近成立的虹口上海牲畜市场。该市场试图垄断此地的活畜运输与销售，但已有50家猪行公开谴责该计划，并称其为“非法组织”。

据昨日预测，这两派猪商之间的口舌之争可能会演变为实际行动。已知法租界和公共租界内至少有两名猪行经理于昨日收到炸弹，但幸运的是，送出这些“礼物”的人并无意引发爆炸。昨晚有人担心，鉴于争端已转化为威胁，且伴随爆炸物寄出的恐吓信是印刷品，其他猪行经理可能已经或将会成为类似的受害者。

带有威胁性的礼物

昨日下午约2时30分，一名中年男子出现在拉斐德路494号一户人家的门口，被引入后，他表示受人之托向主人呈献一份礼物。话音刚落，他便留下了一封信和一个包裹，随后逃离。后经检查，包裹内装有一枚手榴弹和两发子弹。

该户主是顾宝贤（Koo Po-hsian，音译）先生，系租界内知名的猪商。昨日尚无法确定他在当前争端中的立场，但寄给他的信中指控他已参与新的日资牲畜市场，并警告若他不与新垄断组织划清界限，其生命将面临危险。

就在法国警察昨晚调查此案时，另一份“炸弹礼物”被送给了另一位猪行经理。该经理所在的万生猪行位于浙江路118弄21号。晚上约8时，一名男子前往该行，敲门要求会见经理李成宰（Li Cheng-tsai，音译）先生，称有礼物相赠。

一场误会

当被告知李先生不在时，他让一名行员打开侧门，递上一个包裹和一封信。经查，包裹内装有一枚手榴弹，信中警告李先生不要迁往虹口。信中指出，此举无异于“卖国辱族”。此事后移交老闸捕房处理。经查明，受害猪行曾在中文报纸上刊登广告，声明不加入新的虹口市场，因此该行相关人员怀疑这是一起误会事件。

新的牲畜市场大楼尚未竣工投入使用，但其临时办事处位于虹口扬州路52号。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. 19C. 169/39
1-3-39.
Louza Station,
REPORT
(6)
Date 22nd March, 1939.
Subject Three bombs thrown in Louza District during evening of 1-3-39.
Made by. Det. Inspt. Bennett Forwarded by.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE S. B. REGISTRY No. S. B. D. Date）

Sir,
Detectives on daily routine duty, visiting sources of information usually available to detectives fails to obtain any information respecting this offence.
Special precautions by means of searching are now enforced on all roof gardens by permanent posts of detectives and police.
Resultant of analysis of bomb contents do not assist police in the continuance of enquiries.
No further incidents of a similar nature have occurred since those of 1-3-39.
（批：Pux 23/3）
During the evening of 14-3-39, an armed robbery occurred from Room No. 301 of the Yangtze Hotel, 437 Yunnan Road, when a male Chinese armed with what appeared to be a bomb stole $111.00 from the inmates of this room, he throwing a envelope into the room inscribed in written characters:-
"This bomb is intended as a present to the Dancing Hall, so you lend me several hundred dollars.
If you raise any alarm this bomb will kill two birds with one stone".
No identification was effected in respect to this handwriting (F.I.R. 1001/39 Louza).
Detective enquiries have failed to obtain any information respecting this armed robbery.
Under the circumstances that no further information is available respecting these offences of bomb throwing suggest that file should now be closed.
Copy to S.B. (Direct)
Copy to D.C. (Divn.) through D.O. "A".
（批：20 3 39.）
（批：D.C.S.B. D.L. P.A. to D.C. (Sp. Br.) 23/3. D.D.O. "A" Divn.）

老闸捕房，
报告
(6)
日期：1939年3月22日。
事由：1939年3月1日晚老闸区发生三起投掷炸弹案。
制作人：侦探督察贝内特（Bennett） 转发人：
（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处 特别处登记室 编号 S. B. D. 日期）

先生，
执行日常例行任务的侦探在走访通常的情报来源时，未能获取有关此罪行的任何信息。
目前已通过侦探和警员的固定岗哨，对所有屋顶花园实施搜查等特别预防措施。
对炸弹内容物的分析结果无助于警方继续调查。
自1939年3月1日的事件以来，未再发生类似性质的事件。
（批注：Pux 3月23日）
1939年3月14日晚，云南路437号扬子饭店301室发生持械抢劫案，一名手持看似炸弹武器的华籍男子从该室住客处抢走111.00美元，并向室内投掷一个信封，上面手写着：
“这枚炸弹是送给舞厅的礼物，所以借给我几百美元。
如果你们报警，这枚炸弹将一石二鸟。”
未能对该笔迹进行识别（老闸捕房首次报案记录 1001/39）。
侦探调查未能获取有关这起持械抢劫案的任何信息。
鉴于目前无法获得有关这些投掷炸弹罪行的进一步信息，建议将此案卷宗结案。

副本经“A”区侦探长转送副侦探长（分区）
（批注：1939年3月20日）

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Misc: File No 169/39
Louza Station,
REPORT (5)
Date: March, 8th 1939.

Subject. Three bombs thrown in Louza District during evening of 1-3-39.

Made by Det. Inspt. Bennett. Forwarded by

Sir,
Report received from D.S.I. Twins respecting fragments
of bomb (Bomb 1) which were found on the balcony of the
Oriental Hotel (東亞旅館) Sincere Company:-
"From the fragments recovered it can be deter-
mined that this bomb was of the cigarette tin type,
the explosive content being a fire cracker and
several pieces of metal were contained in the tin.
The method of explosion was most probably by
the cotton fuse, which would have to be set off
before throwing".
D.S.I. Twins.

Analysis report received from Public Health Department
respecting the fragments of powder from the bomb (Bomb 3)
which was thrown on Yu Ya Ching Road:-
"The powder consisted of Arsenic, Potassium
chloride, Chlorate and sand.
The original mixture is identical with the
previous explosives analysed from cigarette tin
bombs, namely:-
Arsenic Sulphate
Potassium Chlorate
Sand".

Though no fragments of the bombs which were thrown in
the Sin Ho Rd (英華街) and Yu Ya Ching Road were found
(Bombs 2 and 3) the discolouring of a yellowish tint on the
roadway, and the colour of the fragments of powder from the
bomb (3) thrown on Yu Ya Ching Road, also of a yellowish
tint, this is similar in colouring to the fragments of the

日期：1939年3月8日。

事由：1939年3月1日晚老闸区发生三起投掷炸弹案。

制作人：侦探督察贝内特（Bennett）。 转发人：

先生，
收到双胞胎侦探副督察（D.S.I. Twins）关于在先施公司东亚旅馆（Oriental Hotel）阳台发现的炸弹（炸弹1）碎片的报告：
“从回收的碎片可以确定，这枚炸弹属于香烟铁盒类型，爆炸物为鞭炮，铁盒内还装有几块金属片。引爆方式极可能是棉引信，需在投掷前点燃。”
双胞胎侦探副督察。

收到公共卫生局关于在虞洽卿路（Yu Ya Ching Road）投掷的炸弹（炸弹3）粉末碎片的分析报告：
“粉末由砷、氯化钾、氯酸盐和沙子组成。
原始混合物与之前分析的香烟铁盒炸弹中的爆炸物相同，即：
硫酸砷
氯酸钾
沙子”。

虽然在英华街（Sin Ho Rd）和虞洽卿路投掷的炸弹（炸弹2和3）未发现碎片，但路面上出现的淡黄色变色痕迹，以及虞洽卿路投掷的炸弹（3）的粉末碎片颜色也呈淡黄色，这与在
